Ramesh Rajagopal
 Co-Founder and CEO 
 Follow on LinkedIn
 Follow on Twitter
Ramesh is co-founder and CEO of Authentic8. Prior to this leadership role, he was VP Corporate Development at Postini running all strategic planning and business development leading up to the acquisition of the company by Google in 2007 for $625 million.
Before Postini, Ramesh was Senior Director of the Corporate Strategy Group at Microsoft, where he co-led a team in identifying and evaluating new growth opportunities for the company in areas including consumer web services, business applications and security.
In his time before Microsoft, Ramesh worked at JP Morgan in both the investment banking and capital markets groups. He holds an MBA in Finance from the University of Chicago and an M.A. in Economics from the University of Cambridge.
Scott Petry
 Co-Founder And Executive Chairman 
 Follow on LinkedIn
 Follow on Twitter
Scott has been using the cloud to disrupt the information security market for nearly 20 years. He founded Postini in 1999, which pioneered the cloud-delivered service model for email security and content compliance, effectively securing SMTP while remaining compatible with every existing mail service. In 2007, Postini was acquired by Google, where Scott remained as Director of Product Management for Google Enterprise to further cloud adoption.
In 2010, he co-founded Authentic8, a secure virtual browser solution designed to address the inherent lack of security in the protocols the world uses to access the web. Silo, its flagship product, executes in the cloud, providing isolation from web code while providing a full-fidelity user experience.
Scott started his career at Apple Computer, worked in the wireless industry (SkyTel) and the open-source industry (Cygnus and Red Hat). He graduated with a B.S. from San Diego State University. As a member of the U.S. National Rowing team, earned a bronze medal in the World Championships.
Kevin Lund
 Chief Technology Officer 
Kevin is chief technical officer of Authentic8. In his earlier career, he led Postini's anti-threat team and served as the principal system architect. When Positini was acquired by Google, Kevin became staff engineer at the tech multinational. Kevin holds a doctorate in psychology from the University of California where he specialized in machine learning and computational psycholinguistics. 
Chirag Vasavada
 Chief Operating Officer / Chief Financial Officer 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Chirag Vasavada is head of finance and business operations at Authentic8, where his responsibilities include finance and strategy, operations and business development functions. Previously, Chirag helped build out the commercial sales and customer success teams.
Prior to joining Authentic8, Chirag spent 13 years investing in and advising technology companies at T Rowe Price, Fidelity and several other investment firms, and he was responsible for building and overseeing finance teams, as well as research and compliance functions. Chirag began his career as a strategy consultant at Accenture and later was a member of the corporate development and strategy team at Microsoft.
Miguel Ramos
 Chief Product Officer 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Miguel is the head of product at Authentic8, responsible for product management and product marketing. Prior to joining Authentic8, Miguel was a corporate strategy director at Forcepoint, where he worked with the senior leadership team to establish Forcepoint’s long-term strategy and identify and evaluate new market opportunities.
Miguel began his career in software engineering, and over the years he held several product management roles at companies such as Forcepoint, Raytheon, Neustar and Network Solutions. Miguel holds an MBA from the University of Toronto Rotman School, an M.S. in Computer Information Systems from Boston University, and a B.Sc. (Hon.) in Mathematics and Computer Science from the University of Toronto.
Nabeel Ahmadieh
 Chief Revenue Officer 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Nabeel is responsible for all sales and marketing efforts at Authentic8. Since joining the company in late 2017, he has played a pivotal role in shaping Authentic8’s go-to-market strategy, refining sales processes, and building high-performing teams. Nabeel has been instrumental in driving revenue growth and has served as a trusted advisor to both public and private sector customers.
Prior to Authentic8, Nabeel was a senior sales leader at immixGroup, where he managed over $250 million in annual cybersecurity sales to the government. In this role, he helped more than 100 technology companies navigate the complexities of selling to the public sector, expanding their federal footprint and accelerating growth.
Nabeel holds a bachelor’s degree from East Carolina University and is based outside of Northern Virginia.
Matt Ashburn
 Chief Customer Officer 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Matt is the Chief Customer Officer, focusing on cross-functional strategy and engagement with customers. Prior to Authentic8, Matt served as a CIA officer focusing on cyber issues, including a detail serving on the National Security Council as the Chief Information Security Officer and Special Advisor to the National Security Advisor, leading technical expertise, risk reduction strategies, and policy for national security systems.
At CIA, Matt led the technical direction and coordination to stand up an innovative, unified cyber security operations center to fully harness agency authorities, resources, and talents to prevent and respond to advanced cyber threats.  He also led the detection watch floor of CIA's cyber incident response team, and has been recognized with a national intelligence award and service ribbon from the Director of National Intelligence and the IC CIO Partnership Award.  
Prior to CIA, Matt gained over 10 years of government and private sector experience focusing on intelligence matters and cyber security initiatives at federal agencies and a major financial institution.  He holds a BS in Electrical Engineering from the University of Virginia and is a graduate of FBI's Intelligence Basic Course at Quantico, VA.  Matt splits his time between Washington, DC and Puerto Rico, and volunteers as a sworn reserve police officer with the DC Metropolitan Police.
Christina Calderon
 Head of Human Resources 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Christina is the head of human resources for Authentic8. She has more than 15 years of experience working with small to mid-size technology companies, implementing human resources infrastructure and strategy.
Christina has a B.S. in Business Administration from San Francisco State and an MBA in Finance from Notre Dame de Namur University. She holds SPHR-CA and SHRM-SCP certifications in Human Resources.
Mike Burwick
 VP, Technical Engagement 
 Follow on LinkedIn
Mike Burwick serves as Vice President of Technical Engagement at Authentic8, overseeing Sales Engineering, Professional Services, and Customer Support. In this role, he is responsible for the technical success of Authentic8's enterprise, government, and commercial customers across every stage of the customer journey — including organizations that use the Silo platform for cyber threat intelligence, OSINT investigations, financial crime compliance, and incident response workflows.
Since joining Authentic8 in 2019 as Director of Sales Engineering, Mike has built and scaled the technical customer organization while working closely with product and engineering to translate client requirements into platform capabilities. He also leads Authentic8's AI and API integration initiatives, developing automation that connects the Silo platform to customer workflows and Tech Alliance Partner integrations — a key component of the company's evolving AI product strategy.
Before Authentic8, Mike held senior technical roles at Bromium (now HP Wolf Security), Venafi, and Stonesoft (now Forcepoint), building deep expertise in virtualization, endpoint security, PKI and certificate management, and network security architecture.
Mike holds a B.S.E. in Electrical Engineering from John Brown University.
